title: Arusha gateway system
framing: Arusha is not only the place before safari. It can be arrival buffer, Mount Meru base, Arusha National Park day, coffee/highland context or a deliberate recovery night between very different Tanzania chapters.

roles.name: Arrival & reset
roles.note: Protect sleep, luggage, money, SIM/logistics and a calm first day rather than launching immediately into a long road transfer.
roles.tradeoff: Adds a night but usually improves the rest of the journey.

roles.name: Arusha National Park
roles.best_for: Compact wildlife + forest + Momella / Ngurdoto context
roles.note: A useful first wildlife day with forest, lakes, giraffe, primates and Mount Meru scenery; not a substitute for major safari parks.
roles.tradeoff: Wildlife density and predator expectations should remain modest.

roles.name: Mount Meru
roles.note: A serious mountain in its own right and, for some travellers, a useful pre-Kilimanjaro acclimatisation chapter.
roles.tradeoff: Requires real days and fitness; do not treat it as a casual add-on.

roles.name: Coffee & highland context
roles.note: The foothills and coffee-growing highlands can give the arrival region more meaning before the journey moves into protected areas.
roles.tradeoff: Should be locally specific rather than a generic 'coffee tour' checkbox.

stay_logic.note: Valid for experienced travellers on an efficient arrival, but fragile after delays or long-haul travel.
Best general arrival buffer before mountain or safari.
Allows Arusha National Park, coffee/highland context or a proper recovery day.
Only when Mount Meru, work/meeting, family context or deeper northern-highland travel is itself part of the journey.

publication_rules: Do not present Arusha as only a transfer town.
Do not imply Arusha National Park substitutes for a major safari circuit.
Do not describe Mount Meru as an easy acclimatisation walk.
Avoid exact transfer times without current traffic/road context.
